page.overview:
Who is Viki?

Viki was a widowed royal family member from a far-off land with the coat of arms of a zebra.

Around , a coup was instigated in her kingdom and the royal family was overthrown. She and her son boarded one of two ships set for Beauclair, where they were likely seeking asylum.

However, the usurper back home sent warriors after them and one of the ships wrecked on an island in Skellige, though luckily Viki and the young boy were on the other ship. The two made it as far as Ursten in Velen before their ship also crashed, stranding them in a foreign land and, to make matters worse, Viki couldn't speak any of the local language. They then took refuge in Widows' Grotto as Viki tried to figure out what to do next.
